notes.title: Kickstarter Live, Demo Fixes/Updates, and Lots More!
notes.content: [h1]Hello![/h1][p][/p][p][b]Wow, what a crazy week![/b] Star Garden's Kickstarter launched on September 2 and was fully funded in just two hours. Thank you all so much for your support! [/p][p][/p][p][b]If you're interested in preordering a copy of the full game at a discounted price, check out the link below:[/b][/p][p][url="http://www.getstargarden.com/" style="button" buttoncolor="#1e00ff"]Preorder today![/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322409/cd5a3eb4beb083e3fd081c0de3a19dd32767a45d.png"][/img][/p][h2]We have a lot of news to cover here, but let's start with something really important...[/h2][p][/p][p]If you played Star Garden: The Trial on Day 1, you may have ran into some nasty bugs that never came up for us while testing. [b]We're extremely sorry for the inconvenience.[/b] However, these bugs were fixed a day later! We hope you give the demo another shot after updating, and please know that we are continuing to fix any bugs we find![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.discord.gg/gamegarage" style="button" buttoncolor="#0077ff"]Click to join our Discord![/url][/p][p][/p][p]If you run into bugs, feel free to let us know on our official Discord! [b][i]We're always looking! We never sleep![/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]In other news, if you didn't know, David Humphrey (who you may know as the original VA of a certain "Ultimate Lifeform") will be the voice of Lynx in Star Garden![/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p]Is Lynx a friend or a foe? Find out in Story Mode when the full game releases![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322409/9bd78f68fdae31cbb54fe86f0af99f6e01cfca97.png"][/img][/p][p][b][i]Also, Zeno Robinson will be voicing Jack Flash from ENDLESS FANTASIA as part of a FREE collab in Star Garden![/i][/b] ENDLESS FANTASIA is an awesome comic book that is also currently on Kickstarter. After the full game releases, we plan to release a FREE DLC collab pack for FREE![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322409/5ff51dea68bac18ab1ffaefe48bcf89b41c53cce.png"][/img][/p][p]On our Kickstarter, we've hit a ton of our stretch goals. Thank you all so much! [b][i]We're so close to our next one, which will add a new set of Lumi evolutions and a new vehicle type, the Air Skates![/i][/b] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322409/a25081226917ac57dc7b5057a08f80883b60f885.png"][/img][b][i]We'll be sure to update you all more on our Steam page in the future! Seriously, we can't thank you enough for all your support so far![/i][/b] [/p]

notes.title: Parkour Gameplay Spotlight!
notes.content:
Parkour in Star Garden! Rail Grind while performing stylish tricks, Wall Ride across billboards, and use Zero Gravity on certain structures.

[previewyoutube=r-2O8aS_-HM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Basic Defense Gameplay Spotlight!
notes.content:
In Star Garden, smart defense keeps you in the match. Use your Orbital Shield to block, Side Dodge to slip past danger, Throw to break an opponent's guard, and Parry at the perfect moment to land a wide open hit.

[previewyoutube=PZ-cWsKRR1c;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Basic Combat Gameplay Spotlight!
notes.content:
In Star Garden, you can ram into obstacles or opponents, or use spin attacks to deal damage! Try Neutral Spin for a quick AoE attack, Forward Spin to launch your Lumi forward into enemies, or Upward Spin to strike airborne foes. All work on land, in air, or underwater.

[previewyoutube=WwpkE6HE1_U;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Swimming Gameplay Spotlight!
notes.content:
In Star Garden, you can swim in the water with your Lumi! The greater your Swim stat, the faster you’ll move through water and the higher you’ll jump when performing a Splash Boost. 

[previewyoutube=otib8UQUeB0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Trick System Gameplay Spotlight!
notes.content:
Star Garden lets you show off midair! Press a direction and the Trick button while airborne to perform a stylish move. Chaining them into a combo builds a powerful speed boost when landing.

[previewyoutube=Wu_u8lg9HKw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Wishlist Stretch Goal Cleared!
notes.content:
We're on Wave 2 of our Wishlist Stretch Goals, and with 20,000 total wishlists for Star Garden, we've cleared Goal 1!

This unlocks Faux forms for every current and future Star Garden character! These metallic doppelganger costumes of the main cast of characters lets player suit up in a menacing, alternate look.

But we're just getting started! Let's keep unlocking even more exciting new content through the Wishlist Stretch Goals. Make sure to tell your friends and family to wishlist Star Garden on Steam to help support our game and give the community new content.


Next up: two BRAND NEW characters—let’s keep pushing toward the next goal together! 💫
